summary: On 2026-09-29 Iovance raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $410-420M from $350-370M (above ~$403M consensus) on strong US Amtagvi and Proleukin demand; shares rose ~24-39% that day on heavy volume.
support_reason: Guidance raise backed by record Q2 revenue ($99.3M, +66% YoY) and expanding treatment-center footprint.
dilution_or_offering: none found; no S-3/424B since mid-August, only 8-K and Forms 3/4
short_interest_or_squeeze: Coverage cites short covering fueling the gap; no short-interest figure found
